FROM node:22-bookworm

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate

WORKDIR /app

# Clone, pin to base commit, then strip .git so the agent cannot inspect fix PR /
# future history (anti-cheat). Re-init a single base commit + immutable tag so the
# verifier can reset test files; git apply still works without upstream history.
RUN git clone https://github.com/radix-ui/primitives /app \
 && git -C /app checkout e251bc6791a8c5f0c3dcabbf4f070f2bc9db46ab \
 && rm -rf /app/.git \
 && git -C /app init -q \
 && git -C /app -c user.email=h@l -c user.name=h add -A \
 && git -C /app -c user.email=h@l -c user.name=h commit -q -m base \
 && git -C /app tag harbor_base

# Pre-install dependencies so verify time doesn't wait on the network.
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts

# Visual evidence, readable by the agent at /app/.harbor_assets/.
# tests/ and solution/ are intentionally NOT copied — the harness supplies them at verify time.
RUN mkdir -p /logs /app/.harbor_assets
COPY assets/ /app/.harbor_assets/

CMD ["bash"]

2	# Behavioral verifier for radix-ui-primitives-2611-mm.
3	# Applies the PR's test additions, runs f2p+p2p, computes reward from the test report.

8	STDERR_LOG=/logs/verifier/test-stderr.txt
9	REPORT=/logs/verifier/report.xml

13	trap ensure_reward EXIT

16	
17	# Restore any test paths the agent may have edited to their pristine base state
18	# before applying test.patch, so agent edits to tests cannot change scoring.
19	for _p in $(grep '^+++ b/' /tests/test.patch | sed 's#^+++ b/##'); do
20	  git -C /app checkout harbor_base -- "$_p" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "/app/$_p" 2>/dev/null || true
21	done

23	echo "== applying test.patch ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Behavioral verifier for radix-ui-primitives-2611-mm.
# Applies the PR's test additions, runs f2p+p2p, computes reward from the test report.
# NEVER greps source for the fix — it runs the tests.
set -uo pipefail
mkdir -p /logs/verifier
STDOUT_LOG=/logs/verifier/test-stdout.txt
STDERR_LOG=/logs/verifier/test-stderr.txt
REPORT=/logs/verifier/report.xml
: > "$STDOUT_LOG"; : > "$STDERR_LOG"

ensure_reward() { [ -f /logs/verifier/reward.txt ] || echo 0 > /logs/verifier/reward.txt; }
trap ensure_reward EXIT

cd /app || { echo "no /app" | tee -a "$STDERR_LOG"; exit 1; }

# Restore any test paths the agent may have edited to their pristine base state
# before applying test.patch, so agent edits to tests cannot change scoring.
for _p in $(grep '^+++ b/' /tests/test.patch | sed 's#^+++ b/##'); do
  git -C /app checkout harbor_base -- "$_p" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "/app/$_p" 2>/dev/null || true
done

echo "== applying test.patch ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
git apply --binary /tests/test.patch 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || git apply /tests/test.patch 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || patch -p1 -i /tests/test.patch 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || { echo "ERROR: could not apply test.patch" | tee -a "$STDERR_LOG"; exit 1; }

echo "== installing pinned test-only deps ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
# No extra test-only deps needed; pnpm install was done in the Dockerfile.

echo "== running f2p + p2p tests ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
# Run only the context-menu test file into a JUnit XML report.
pnpm vitest run \
  --reporter=junit \
  --outputFile="$REPORT" \
  packages/react/context-menu/src/context-menu.test.tsx \
  >>"$STDOUT_LOG" 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || echo "(vitest exited non-zero; parsing report)" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"

echo "== computing reward ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
# Rubric judge - SUB-AGENT backend: no API key, no network. On the first pass there is no
# verdict yet, so judge.py writes a judge request under /logs/verifier/judge/ and prints
# nothing. The `|| echo ""` is load-bearing: the judge must never be able to fail the run.
RUBRIC=""
if [ -f /tests/rubrics.json ]; then
  RUBRIC=$(python3 /tests/judge.py --rubrics /tests/rubrics.json --repo /app \
             2>/logs/verifier/judge.log || echo "")
  echo "Rubric verdict: ${RUBRIC:-pending (judge request written; rescore after grading)}"
fi

python3 /tests/verifier.py 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
echo "reward=$(cat /logs/verifier/reward.txt 2>/dev/null)" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Verifier for radix-ui-primitives-2611-mm (ContextMenu re-anchor).

Reward policy:
  1.0 — every f2p passes AND every p2p passes.
  0.5 — every f2p passes but ≥1 p2p regressed; or strict subset of f2p passes.
  0.0 — no f2p passes, or the suite failed to run.
"""
import json, os, re, sys, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

CONF = json.load(open('/tests/config.json'))
F2P, P2P = CONF['f2p'], CONF['p2p']
REPORT = '/logs/verifier/report.xml'
REWARD = '/logs/verifier/reward.txt'


def load_results():
    """Return {test_identifier: 'pass'|'fail'|'skip'} parsed from JUnit XML."""
    results = {}
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
        return results
    try:
        tree = ET.parse(REPORT)
    except ET.ParseError as e:
        print(f"XML parse error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return results
    for tc in tree.iter('testcase'):
        classname = tc.get('classname', '')
        name = tc.get('name', '')
        # Build two keys: full qualified and name-only for flexible matching
        full_key = f"{classname}::{name}".strip('::')
        failed = any(c.tag in ('failure', 'error') for c in tc)
        skipped = any(c.tag == 'skipped' for c in tc)
        status = 'skip' if skipped else ('fail' if failed else 'pass')
        results[full_key] = status
        # Also store by name alone for substring matching
        if name and name not in results:
            results[name] = status
    return results


def matched(idents, results):
    """Match each identifier against reported test names (substring/regex tolerant)."""
    out = {}
    for ident in idents:
        hit = next(
            (v for k, v in results.items()
             if ident in k or re.search(re.escape(ident), k)),
            None
        )
        out[ident] = hit or 'missing'
    return out


def main():
    r = load_results()
    f2p_matched = matched(F2P, r)
    p2p_matched = matched(P2P, r)

    f2p_pass = [k for k, v in f2p_matched.items() if v == 'pass']
    p2p_pass = [k for k, v in p2p_matched.items() if v == 'pass']

    all_f2p = len(f2p_pass) == len(F2P) and len(F2P) > 0
    all_p2p = len(p2p_pass) == len(P2P)

    if all_f2p and all_p2p:
        reward = 1.0
    elif f2p_pass and (not all_p2p or not all_f2p):
        reward = 0.5
    else:
        reward = 0.0

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(REWARD), exist_ok=True)
    open(REWARD, 'w').write(str(reward))
    print(json.dumps({'reward': reward, 'f2p': f2p_matched, 'p2p': p2p_matched}))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

9	
10	  Phase 1 (during the verifier run)
11	      No verdict exists yet, so this writes a self-contained judge request into the judge
12	      dir -- criteria_payload.json, source.txt (the candidate diff), PROMPT.md -- prints
13	      nothing, and exits 0. The verifier then scores on tests alone.
14	
15	  Phase 2 (after the run, orchestrated outside the container)
16	      A judge sub-agent reads PROMPT.md and writes verdict.json next to it. Re-running this
17	      script (or `mm_run.sh <task> rescore`) reads that verdict and prints "pass" or "fail".
18	
19	Because the judge never calls out, there is no proxy, no bridge, no credentials, and no
20	[verifier.env] block anywhere.
21	
22	Contract (test.sh depends on all three):
23	  * prints "pass" or "fail" on stdout, or NOTHING when no verdict is available yet
24	  * writes the per-criterion detail to <judge dir>/summary.json
25	  * ALWAYS exits 0, so the judge can never fail the run
26	
27	Env:
28	  PB_JUDGE_DIR      where the request/verdict live (default /logs/verifier/judge)
29	  PB_JUDGE_VERDICT  explicit path to verdict.json (overrides the default location)
30	
31	IMPORTANT: never name a file in tests/ after a stdlib module (select.py, json.py, types.py,
32	io.py, queue.py). It shadows the real module and the failure surfaces somewhere unrelated.
33	The sys.path strip below defends against it.
34	"""
35	import os
36	import sys
37	
38	_self_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
39	sys.path[:] = [p for p in sys.path if os.path.abspath(p or os.getcwd()) != _self_dir]
40	
41	import argparse
42	import json
43	import re
44	import subprocess
45	from pathlib import Path
46	
47	DEFAULT_JUDGE_DIR = "/logs/verifier/judge"
48	# Hunks for these paths never reach the judge: it must grade the fix, not the harness the
49	# submission may have edited.
50	EXCLUDE_RE = re.compile(
51	    r"(\.test\.[jt]sx?$|\.spec\.[jt]sx?$|(^|/)tests?/|(^|/)__tests__/|"
52	    r"(^|/)__snapshots__/|(^|/)node_modules/|(^|/)\.git/)"
53	)
54	BASE_REFS = ("harbor_base", "HEAD")
55	
56	JUDGE_SYSTEM = (
57	    "You are a strict senior engineer grading the APPROACH of a code change -- not whether "
58	    "its tests pass. Score each rubric criterion STRICTLY BINARY: 1 = fully satisfied, "
59	    "0 = not satisfied. There is NO partial credit: if a criterion is only partially met, "
60	    "ambiguous, or has no clear evidence, score 0. Be strict; when unsure, score 0."
61	)
62	
63	
64	def judge_dir() -> Path:
65	    return Path(os.environ.get("PB_JUDGE_DIR") or DEFAULT_JUDGE_DIR)
66	
67	
68	def candidate_diff(repo: str, budget: int = 120_000) -> str:
69	    for ref in BASE_REFS:
70	        try:
71	            out = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, "diff", ref],
72	                                 capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
73	        except Exception as exc:
74	            sys.stderr.write("[judge] git diff failed: %s\n" % exc)
75	            return ""
76	        if out.returncode == 0 and out.stdout.strip():
77	            sys.stderr.write("[judge] diffing against %s\n" % ref)
78	            return filter_diff(out.stdout, budget)
79	    sys.stderr.write("[judge] no non-empty diff found\n")
80	    return ""
81	
82	
83	def filter_diff(diff: str, budget: int) -> str:
84	    kept, cur, keep = [], [], True
85	    for line in diff.splitlines(keepends=True):
86	        if line.startswith("diff --git "):
87	            if keep and cur:
88	                kept.extend(cur)
89	            parts = line.split()
90	            path = parts[-1][2:] if len(parts) >= 4 else ""
91	            keep = not EXCLUDE_RE.search(path)
92	            cur = [line]
93	        else:
94	            cur.append(line)
95	    if keep and cur:
96	        kept.extend(cur)
97	    blob = "".join(kept)
98	    return blob[:budget] + "\n[... truncated ...]\n" if len(blob) > budget else blob
99	
100	
101	def write_request(criteria, diff, jdir: Path) -> None:
102	    """Lay down everything a judge sub-agent needs, with no further context."""
103	    jdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
104	    payload = [{"id": c["id"], "criterion": c["criterion"]} for c in criteria]
105	    (jdir / "criteria_payload.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
106	    (jdir / "source.txt").write_text(diff)
107	    verdict = jdir / "verdict.json"
108	    ids = ", ".join(c["id"] for c in criteria)
109	    (jdir / "PROMPT.md").write_text(f"""# Rubric judge (sub-agent)
110	
111	You are the rubric judge. Grade the APPROACH of a code change, not whether its tests pass.
112	
113	System contract:
114	{JUDGE_SYSTEM}
115	
116	Inputs in this directory ({jdir}):
117	- `criteria_payload.json` — {len(criteria)} criteria, each {{id, criterion}}.
118	- `source.txt` — the candidate diff. Test, spec and snapshot files are already stripped out,
119	  so everything you see is product code the submission changed.
120	
121	Score each criterion **1 or 0 — never 0.5 or any fraction**. 1 = fully satisfied,
122	0 = not satisfied, ambiguous, or no clear evidence. Be strict; when unsure, score 0.
123	
124	The rubric is unweighted and every criterion is mandatory: a single 0 fails the whole rubric,
125	so do not withhold a 1 over style preferences the criterion does not actually state.
126	
127	Write ONLY this JSON to `{verdict}`:
128	
129	    {{"scores": {{"<criterion id>": {{"score": 0|1}}, ...}}}}
130	
131	All {len(criteria)} ids must appear: {ids}. Verify the file parses before you finish.
132	""")
133	
134	
135	def read_verdict(criteria, jdir: Path):
136	    """Return ("pass"|"fail", failed_ids) or None when no usable verdict exists."""
137	    vp = Path(os.environ.get("PB_JUDGE_VERDICT") or (jdir / "verdict.json"))
138	    if not vp.is_file():
139	        return None
140	    try:
141	        obj = json.loads(vp.read_text())
142	    except Exception as exc:
143	        sys.stderr.write("[judge] verdict unreadable (%s)\n" % exc)
144	        return None
145	    scores = obj.get("scores", obj)
146	    if not isinstance(scores, dict):
147	        sys.stderr.write("[judge] verdict has no scores map\n")
148	        return None
149	    failed, graded = [], 0
150	    for c in criteria:
151	        raw = scores.get(c["id"])
152	        if raw is None:
153	            failed.append(c["id"])            # not graded == not demonstrated == fail
154	            continue
155	        try:
156	            v = float(raw.get("score") if isinstance(raw, dict) else raw)
157	        except (TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError):
158	            failed.append(c["id"])
159	            continue
160	        graded += 1
161	        if v < 1.0:                            # strictly binary: only a full 1 passes
162	            failed.append(c["id"])
163	    if graded == 0:
164	        sys.stderr.write("[judge] verdict contained no usable scores\n")
165	        return None
166	    return ("fail" if failed else "pass"), failed
167	
168	
169	def main() -> int:
170	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
171	    ap.add_argument("--rubrics", required=True)
172	    ap.add_argument("--repo", default="/app")
173	    ap.add_argument("--judge-dir", default=None)
174	    a = ap.parse_args()
175	
176	    jdir = Path(a.judge_dir) if a.judge_dir else judge_dir()
177	    try:
178	        doc = json.load(open(a.rubrics))
179	    except Exception as exc:
180	        sys.stderr.write("[judge] cannot read %s: %s\n" % (a.rubrics, exc))
181	        return 0
182	    criteria = [c for c in (doc.get("criteria") or []) if c.get("id") and c.get("criterion")]
183	    if not criteria:
184	        sys.stderr.write("[judge] no criteria in %s\n" % a.rubrics)
185	        return 0
186	
187	    # Phase 2: a verdict is already there -> score it.
188	    res = read_verdict(criteria, jdir)
189	    if res is not None:
190	        verdict, failed = res
191	        try:
192	            jdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
193	            json.dump({"rubric": verdict, "failed": failed,
194	                       "criteria_total": len(criteria)},
195	                      open(jdir / "summary.json", "w"), indent=2)
196	        except Exception:
197	            pass
198	        sys.stderr.write("[judge] verdict=%s%s\n"
199	                         % (verdict, (" failed=%s" % ", ".join(failed)) if failed else ""))
200	        print(verdict)
201	        return 0
202	
203	    # Phase 1: no verdict yet -> lay down the request and stay silent.
204	    diff = candidate_diff(a.repo)
205	    if not diff.strip():
206	        sys.stderr.write("[judge] empty candidate diff; nothing to grade\n")
207	        return 0
208	    write_request(criteria, diff, jdir)
209	    sys.stderr.write(

211	        "(criteria_payload.json, source.txt, PROMPT.md). Have the judge sub-agent produce "
212	        "verdict.json, then rescore. Scoring on tests alone until then.\n"

214	    return 0

216
